claims.claim: Ablations show the agent solves 4 Putnam 2025 problems without the informal prover, 11 with the informal prover, and all 12 with the subagent setup (Table 2).
claims.evidence: The logbook contains no ablation experiments or any mention of rerunning the without-informal-prover, with-informal-prover, or subagent configurations described in Table 2.

raw_verdict.overall: This logbook establishes that released formal artifacts (12 Putnam proofs and one Brascamp-Lieb declaration) kernel-check without sorryAx, providing partial support for the existence and validity of these artifacts. It does not rerun the agent, verify the agent's role in generating the proofs, address ablations, or confirm the system architecture or mathematician interaction.
